beats.vo_text: Ye kahani kisi social media afwaah par nahi, balki Fateh Rahben Darwaza aur 400-foot unchi Bala Hissar ramparts par darj hai. Lekin 1518 mein Sultan Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah aur Royal Courtesan Taramati ke sath ek aisi ghatna ghati jisne is poore ilaaqe ki taqdeer badal di.

beats.vo_text: Sabse khaufnaak hadsa tab report hua jab night survey officers ne ramparts ki aakhri deewar par ek aisi parchhai dekhi jo hawa mein 3 foot upar tairti hui khandar ki khidki mein gayab ho gayi! Chashmadeedo ke mutabiq unhone deewar par dekha ki sadiyon purana ek saya bina zameen ko chhue tezi se unki taraf badh raha tha! Unhone cheekh kar kaha: 'Kaan mein aisi aawaz aayi jaise koi bilkul gale ke paas khada hokar gaa raha ho!' — aur unke paas wahan se bhaagne ke siva koi rasta nahi bacha tha!
